entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hello Sarah. I'm calling because I need to return my new VeloBand GPS Tracker, but I've run into a bit of a snag.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered on January 6th, about seven days ago. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference, it works fine. The main issue is that I tried to process the return two days ago, but there was a significant website error. The entire returns portal seemed to be experiencing a system down event.
I'm very sorry to hear about the trouble with our site. That must have been frustrating.

It was. I just couldn't print the label or get anything to load. I actually took a screenshot of the error message because I was worried this would happen. Look, I imagine I might be just outside the return window now because of that delay. Could we maybe work something out, like a partial credit, and I'll just keep the device?
I appreciate you explaining that, and I do apologize for the website issue. However, there's no need for any negotiation on this. You're actually well within our return period.
Really? I was sure I read it was a very short window for new electronics.

Not at all. Our standard return policy for the VeloBand is 10 days from the date of delivery. Since you've only had it for a week, you have plenty of time. I can process this full return for you right now.
Oh! Well, that's fantastic news. That's much simpler than I thought. Yes, please go ahead.
Of course. I've just initiated the return and sent a new prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You can just print that out and attach it to the box.
Perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
